title: kbtail.py shows a followed item's run state moves, asks and answers from coord among its tool lines
goal: `kbtail.py` shows among a followed session's lines the coord events of its item within 3 seconds of their post: each run state move with its step and gates; each ask addressed to its item or session with the question text from its key; the answer to such an ask with its text; an ask to another item is not shown; every text passes the same redaction and cut; `--once` shows the item's events since the session started

run:
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, threading, time
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: a fake claude process needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); C = os.path.join(T, "cfg"); S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=C, COLUMNS="160", KB_COORD_STORE=S)
for k in ("GIT_DIR", "GIT_WORK_TREE", "GIT_INDEX_FILE"):
    env.pop(k, None)
def sh(*a, cwd=T):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
K = os.path.join(T, "clone"); os.makedirs(K)
sh("git", "init", "-q", ".", cwd=K)
sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@b", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "i", cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
WT = os.path.join(K, ".claude", "worktrees", "agent-ST-aaaaaaaa")
sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "work/ST-aaaaaaaa", WT, cwd=K)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); fake = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", fake)
import uuid
sids = {"worker": str(uuid.uuid4())}
homes = {"worker": WT, "main": K}
procs = {}
for who, sid in sids.items():
    base = homes[who]
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(base, "_cache", "coord_hook", sid + ".json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 600, "token": "t"}, f)
    sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, "claim", "session/" + sid, "--ttl", "600", "--holder", "h")
    pdir = os.path.join(C, "projects", "".join(c if c.isalnum() else "-" for c in base)); os.makedirs(pdir, exist_ok=True)
    rec = {"type": "assistant", "cwd": base, "sessionId": sid, "timestamp": "2026-10-26T10:00:00Z", "isSidechain": False,
           "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "planted-%s-line" % who}]}}
    with open(os.path.join(pdir, sid + ".jsonl"), "w") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
    if who == "worker":
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(pdir, sid, "subagents"))
        sub = dict(rec, isSidechain=True, agentId="a1", message={"role": "assistant", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "planted-sub-line"}]})
        with open(os.path.join(pdir, sid, "subagents", "agent-a1.jsonl"), "w") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(sub) + "\n")
    procs[who] = subprocess.Popen([fake, "120"], cwd=base)
import random, string
secret = "sk-" + "".join(random.SystemRandom().choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits) for _ in range(40))
problems = []
def need(cond, what):
    if not cond:
        problems.append(what)
co = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, *a)
try:
    time.sleep(0.5)
    if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbtail.py")):
        print("check failed: _tools/kbtail.py does not exist"); sys.exit(1)
    p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbtail.py"), "--root", K, "ST-aaaaaaaa"], cwd=T, env=env,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    lines = []
    threading.Thread(target=lambda: [lines.append(x) for x in p.stdout], daemon=True).start()
    end = time.monotonic() + 10
    while time.monotonic() < end and not any("planted-worker-line" in x for x in lines):
        time.sleep(0.1)
    need(any("planted-worker-line" in x for x in lines), "the worker's history is not printed")
    co("transition", "run/ST-aaaaaaaa", "--to", "claimed")
    co("transition", "run/ST-aaaaaaaa", "--to", "working", "--field", "step=planted-step")
    co("put", "ask/q1", "--value", "planted-ask-text " + secret, "--revision", "0")
    co("post", "--kind", "ask", "--field", "id=q1", "--field", "to=ST-aaaaaaaa", "--field", "ref=ask/q1")
    co("put", "ask/q2", "--value", "planted-other-ask", "--revision", "0")
    co("post", "--kind", "ask", "--field", "id=q2", "--field", "to=ST-bbbbbbbb", "--field", "ref=ask/q2")
    co("put", "answer/q1", "--value", "planted-answer-text", "--revision", "0")
    co("post", "--kind", "answer", "--field", "id=q1", "--field", "state=completed", "--field", "ref=answer/q1")
    end = time.monotonic() + 3
    want = ("working", "planted-ask-text", "planted-answer-text")
    while time.monotonic() < end and not all(any(w in x for x in lines) for w in want):
        time.sleep(0.1)
    live = "".join(lines)
    for w in want:
        need(w in live, "%s not shown within 3 s of its post" % w)
    need("planted-other-ask" not in live, "an ask to another item is shown")
    need(secret[-20:] not in live, "the ask's secret is shown")
    p.terminate(); p.wait(5)
    ro = sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbtail.py"), "--root", K, "--once", "ST-aaaaaaaa")
    need(ro.returncode == 0, "--once exit %d: %s" % (ro.returncode, ro.stderr[-300:]))
    once = ro.stdout
    for w in want:
        need(w in once, "--once does not show " + w)
    need(secret[-20:] not in once, "--once shows the ask's secret")
finally:
    for q in procs.values():
        q.kill()
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok", "\n--- output\n" + "".join(lines)[-1200:] if "lines" in dir() else "")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)
